server.name: org.giftcardshop/mcp
server.description: Browse the giftcardshop catalog and buy gift cards with Lightning over MCP. No account, no signup.

environmentVariables.description: 64-hex HMAC secret that enables create_order (Lightning checkout). Browsing tools work without it. Requested at https://giftcardshop.org/contact.
environmentVariables.name: GCS_INTERNAL_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Override the public API base. Defaults to https://api.giftcardshop.org.
environmentVariables.name: GCS_API_BASE
